scenes.title: Work from anywhere.
scenes.text: Work from anywhere. With Yeaft, you can change location without leaving your work behind. Just open a browser and connect to your AI team.

scenes.title: Different devices. The same working context.
scenes.text: At home, at the office, or on the move. Reconnect to the same agent and session. Your browser gives you access. Your online agent keeps the working environment in place.

scenes.title: The right role. The next step.
scenes.text: Bring in the right role for each step. An investigator finds the cause. An implementer makes the change. A reviewer checks the result. Clear handoffs move the work forward, without a fixed pipeline.

scenes.title: Define the roles. Set the working rules.
scenes.text: Give each role clear instructions. Add shared project rules, so responsibilities, coding standards, and review expectations stay consistent as the work moves between roles.

scenes.title: Beyond chat. A real workbench.
scenes.text: Go beyond chat with Workbench. Open the actual files. Check command output. See what your agent is doing, and step in when you need to.

scenes.title: From a development goal to execution.
scenes.text: Start with a development goal, clear boundaries, and acceptance criteria. Fix a bug. Add a regression test. Prepare a patch for review. Describe the outcome, rather than every next prompt.

scenes.title: Keep the task moving. Keep control.
scenes.text: Work Center keeps your goal, progress, and evidence in view. Let ready work advance while your agent is online. Step in for decisions, and check the results against your criteria. Work Center is in preview.

scenes.title: Your AI team. Real work. From anywhere.
scenes.text: Work from anywhere. Clear roles. Real tools. Yeaft. Your AI team, doing real work.
